subject: Mutual Action Flight Plan — next steps & stakeholder checklist
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Flight Plan — next steps & stakeholder checklist

Hi Ava — thanks for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum. I included Rishi and Marcus from our side to help with security and procurement details.

Key decisions & decision criteria (as we heard):
- Primary objective: run a 6-week POC to validate latency and cost savings for our inference runtime (target: 50% lower per-token cost vs current baseline).
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 250ms end-to-end for 2k concurrent requests, endpoint throughput >= 150 req/s, and no regressions on your quality evals (patient-safety prompts).
- Compliance gating: SOC 2 evidence + data-retention policy review required before production.

Stakeholder mapping (please confirm / correct):
- Economic buyer: Marcus Reed (CFO) — handles budget approval and contract sign-off.
- Security: Liam O'Connor — security questionnaire, SOC2, architecture review.
- Procurement: procurement@omnihealth.com — legal/PO and standard T&Cs.
- Product/owner: Emma Ruiz — owns POC milestones and acceptance.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week 0 (by 2027-05-25): Deliver MAP v1 + SOC2 evidence summary (attached); schedule security deep-dive. Owner: Stephanie (Redwood).
2) Week 1-2 (by 2027-06-08): Provision POC environment (dedicated capacity) + ingest sample dataset. Owner: OmniHealth (Emma) / Redwood infra.
3) Week 3-6 (by 2027-06-29): Run POC and gather perf/quality metrics; weekly syncs. Owner: Emma / Stephanie.
4) Week 7 (by 2027-07-06): Joint review; procurement to issue PO or escalate. Owner: Marcus Reed / Procurement.

Attachments: MAP_OMH_v1.pdf (outline + milestones), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf. I also attached a SOW draft placeholder for reference (SOW-OMH-2027-142-DRAFT.docx).

Concrete asks from you:
- Please confirm the stakeholder list above (names/emails) and identify the legal/procurement contact who will handle redlines.
- Confirm POC target dates or propose alternatives.
- Indicate any must-have compliance items beyond SOC 2 that should be included in the MAP.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-min security deep-dive once you confirm Liam's availability.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_OMH_v1.pdf (1.2MB), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (420KB), SOW-OMH-2027-142-DRAFT.docx (60KB)

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Flight Plan — next steps & stakeholder checklist

Thanks, Stephanie — great summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Stakeholders: Marcus Reed (CFO) is correct for economic sign-off. Liam will lead security but he asked that we also include our privacy counsel on data-retention specifics — cc'ing him now would be helpful.
- Procurement: procurement@omnihealth.com is the mailbox; the actual reviewer will be K. Singh (procurement) — I'll introduce next thread once we have SOW + pricing baseline.
- Timing: POC weeks look fine, but we need the POC environment to be available by 2027-06-06 instead of 06-08 because of an internal sprint. Can you confirm?

Questions / items to include in the MAP v1.1: 
1) Pricing baseline for the POC (blended monthly estimate + burst allowance).
2) Data handling: clear statement about persistence and KV cache handling during POC.
3) Rollback/fallback plan if model quality regressions observed.

I'll loop in K. Singh after Stephanie shares the SOW with a pricing section. Can you send a short one-pager that Marcus can review (finance prefers one-paragraph summary + annualized cost estimate)?

—Ava

Date: 2027-05-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Flight Plan — next steps & stakeholder checklist

Following up with an updated MAP and a short answers doc for the security questions Ava raised. Changes in this draft: added pricing baseline (POC estimate), explicit data persistence note, and a rollback plan if quality regressions occur.

Summary of changes (quick):
- POC pricing baseline: $12k / 4-week POC (baseline compute + storage + support) with a 20% burst allowance. Annualized target post-POC: $45k - $60k depending on quantization profile.
- Data handling: temporary KV cache persists only for session lifetime during POC; no dataset persistence on shared storage unless explicitly requested. We included a note about data deletion by default at POC end.
- Rollback plan: automatic model fallback to 'compat-v1' if quality drop > 3% on agreed eval suite; manual rollback steps documented in appendix.

I'm attaching: MAP_OMH_v1.pdf (rev A), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf, SOW-OMH-2027-142-DRAFT.docx (pricing section highlighted).

Next suggested steps:
- Stephanie: send one-pager for Marcus (finance) with annualized estimate.
- Ava/Emma: confirm POC start target (requested 2027-06-06).
- Liam: confirm availability for a 60-min security deep-dive; Rishi will present the architecture notes.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_OMH_v1.pdf (rev A), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf, SOW-OMH-2027-142-DRAFT.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-21T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing redlines and SOW prep for OMH (OMH-2027-142)

Internal note — looping in to propose a small commercial concession to expedite the POC approval. Suggested concession: 10% first-year discount on committed capacity if OmniHealth converts within 90 days of POC completion. Rationale: shortens procurement cycles and gives finance a clear conversion trigger.

I also reviewed the SOW draft and flagged the following redlines for legal:
- Add PO acceptance clause (net 30) under 'Payment Terms'.
- Narrow the liability cap for POC activities to fees paid during the POC.
- Include explicit data deletion clause at POC end.

Action items for us: 
- Rishi: finalize pricing numbers in the SOW (highlighted items).
- Stephanie: prepare the one-pager for Marcus Reed and be ready to send to procurement after redline review.

Marcus Lin
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
